mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t1.id, t1.dept_name AS NAME, t1.parent_id, t1.remark, t1.CODE, t1.create_time, ! ISNULL( t2.id ) as existUser FROM bp_dept t1 LEFT JOIN bp_user_dept t2 ON t1.id = t2.dept_id AND t2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t1.create_time

select t1.user_id, t1.user_name, t1.login_name from bp_user t1 left join bp_user_dept t2 on t2.dept_id= #{deptId} and t2.is_deleted=0 and t1.user_id=t2.user_id where t1.is_deleted= 0 and t1.id != 1 and t2.id is null
and (user_name like concat('%',#{name},'%') or login_name like concat('%',#{name},'%'))

SELECT DISTINCT t3.id AS id FROM bp_dept t1 JOIN bp_user_dept t2 ON t1.id = t2.dept_id JOIN bp_dept t3 ON t3.CODE LIKE CONCAT( t1.CODE, '%' ) WHERE t1.is_deleted = FALSE and t2.is_deleted = FALSE
AND t2.user_id = #{userId}

select t1.user_id,t1.user_name,t1.login_name from bp_user t1 left join bp_user_dept t2 on t2.is_deleted=0 and t1.user_id=t2.user_id -- 排除管理员账号 where t1.is_deleted=0 and t1.id != 1 and t2.id is null
and (user_name like concat('%',#{name},'%') or login_name like concat('%',#{name},'%'))

select t2.user_id,t2.user_name,t2.login_name from bp_user_dept t1 left join bp_user t2 on t1.user_id=t2.user_id and t2.is_deleted=0 where t1.is_deleted=0 and t1.dept_id= #{deptId}
and (t2.user_name like concat('%',#{name},'%') or t2.login_name like concat('%',#{name},'%'))
select count(*) from bp_user where is_deleted = 0 and state = #{status}

#{item}
